comparison.objective: Candidate tunes and locks a damper; record divides object-sorting categories between a human and robot.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires precise hex-key and collar manipulation plus test cycling; record requires semantic categorization, pick-and-place, and cooperative role adherence.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate has quantified dynamic and retention conditions. Board record omits setup, scoring, category definitions, placement tolerances, and run limit.
comparison.reason: Cooperative semantic sorting does not test mechanical calibration or energy absorption.
